mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.space_no, p.area, p.type, p.status, p.owner_id, p.plate_no, p.monthly_fee, p.rent_start, p.rent_end, p.create_time, o.name AS ownerName, o.phone AS ownerPhone FROM t_parking p LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON o.id = p.owner_id

sql.if: AND (p.space_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.plate_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.area LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: ORDER BY p.area ASC, p.space_no ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_parking p LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON o.id = p.owner_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_parking (space_no, area, type, status, owner_id, plate_no, monthly_fee, rent_start, rent_end, create_time) VALUES (#{spaceNo}, #{area}, #{type}, #{status}, #{ownerId}, #{plateNo}, #{monthlyFee}, #{rentStart}, #{rentEnd}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_parking SET space_no = #{spaceNo}, area = #{area}, type = #{type}, status = #{status}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, plate_no = #{plateNo}, monthly_fee = #{monthlyFee}, rent_start = #{rentStart}, rent_end = #{rentEnd} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_parking SET owner_id = #{ownerId}, plate_no = #{plateNo}, status = '已租用', rent_start = CURDATE(), rent_end = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_parking SET owner_id = NULL, plate_no = NULL, status = '空闲', rent_start = NULL, rent_end = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_parking WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(monthly_fee), 0) FROM t_parking WHERE status = '已租用'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_parking WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId}
